subject.title: fix(gateway): exit 0 on EADDRINUSE when healthy OpenClaw gateway is already running

question: Should this stale conflicting PR be closed as superseded by the current supervisor-aware exit-78 implementation, or should a maintainer sponsor a current-main replacement for stricter auth/TLS-aware duplicate-gateway probing?
rationale: The protected maintainer label prevents cleanup closure, and the remaining choice mixes product exit-code policy with auth-provider and availability risk that automation should not settle.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Treat current main and v2026.6.11 exit-78 supervisor behavior as the accepted fix, and ask for a fresh focused PR only if a remaining probe gap is still desired.

options.title: Sponsor a replacement
options.body: Rebuild the probe idea on current main while preserving exit-78 systemd behavior, trusted-proxy source checks, IPv6 bind handling, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Accept exit-0 direction
options.body: Maintainership can intentionally choose exit 0 for healthy conflicts, but that would need an explicit compatibility decision against the shipped systemd policy.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Treat current main and v2026.6.11 exit-78 supervisor behavior as the accepted fix, and ask for a fresh focused PR only if a remaining probe gap is still desired.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shipped EADDRINUSE supervisor policy traces to Peter Steinberger's recent fix commit, making him the best available decision owner for preserving or changing it.
